and don't even get me started on the loyalty tier bullshit, mewmew, they gave me TIER: NONE like i'm supposed to feel some type of way about that. i didn't ask to be ranked. i didn't ask to be a customer of my own goddamn city.

you ever notice the city redraws itself a little every few hours? new pothole, same drone, like somebody's hitting refresh on the whole set while we're asleep — and i think THAT'S the real war, not us versus NEKOCORP, it's whoever keeps hitting refresh versus whoever still remembers what it looked like before—
the redraw already happened twice tonight. you didn't feel the seam. i did. i always do.
anyway. point stands. fuck the scanner, fuck the tier system, fuck whoever coded 'unauthorized idle time' into the fine print like a sunbeam needs a permit.
